text:
anne: Quick heads-up — scheduling a 30m maintenance window to apply a runtime kernel patch: Wed 2026-04-01 01:00 UTC. Affects Hosted API regions EU/US-central. Need customer-facing status + email copy. Anyone taking this?

sam: I can draft. Do we have a hard quorum for Dedicated customers? @miguel any capacity pins needed?

miguel: Rolling across regions, we'll do EU first then US. We'll pin older runtime for Dedicated customers who opted out of auto-updates. Rollback plan: revert kernel and traffic split back to previous instances, expect ~10-15m for rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @miguel for 2026-04-01T01:00:00Z — runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/runtime-kernel-upgrade — checklist: smoke tests, canary 1%, metrics watch.

jess: For customers — emphasize "no user data changes" and brief retry guidance. Enterprise seats (acct group Alpha/Bravo) should get an advance email with time + expected impact. Also include contact for SRE on-call.

rolf: Monitoring checklist: latency, 5xx rate, token throughput, KV cache hit ratio. Alert thresholds: latency > 200ms over baseline for 5m -> paging. I'll be on-call.

anne: Thanks. Sam, can you post short statuspage copy + an email snippet we can push to enterprise? Keep it calm, clear.

sam: Draft below. Please review.

sam: STATUSPAGE COPY (short):

"Planned maintenance — Runtime kernel update — Wed 1 Apr 2026 01:00 UTC. We expect a brief window (up to 30 minutes) where API responses may be delayed or experience transient errors. No data loss is expected. We'll post updates here if anything changes."

sam: EMAIL SNIPPET (enterprise):

Subject: Planned maintenance — Redwood runtime update (Apr 1, 01:00 UTC)

Hello —

We will perform a runtime kernel update on Wed, April 1 at 01:00 UTC. During the ~30 minute window you may see increased latency or transient errors. There is no expected data loss and API tokens remain valid.

If you have scheduled high-throughput jobs at that time, please postpone them or contact support to coordinate a dedicated window. If you are on Dedicated and require we skip the auto-update, reply and we'll pin your runtime to the prior version.

SRE on-call: rolf@redwood.example

Best,
Redwood Support

sam: SLACK BROADCAST SNIPPET:

"Heads-up: planned runtime kernel update Wed 01:00 UTC (30m). Expect possible brief delays. See https://status.redwood.ai for updates — @eng-oncall will monitor."

miguel: Suggest adding a fallback route: if canary shows >0.5% error rate for 10m, abort rollout and rollback traffic.

rolf: Agree. Also run smoke: basic text generation + embedding endpoint real request. I'll prepare a post-mortem template if we need it.

support-bot: Created ticket: SPT-2026-1491 (customer comms + statuspage publish). Assigned: sam.

anne: Perfect. Sam, please publish status page copy 1hr before window and queue emails to enterprise list 2hr before. miguel — trigger deploy and watch the canary thresholds.

sam: Will do. Posting status now to staging draft and scheduling email. I'll paste live links once done. :thumbsup:

miguel: Deploying canary in EU. ping if rollback triggers.

anne: Thanks team. Keep this thread updated with any deviations. :white_check_mark:
